name: Scrumball
description: Find creators, follow outreach campaigns, triage creator emails and review team usage on Scrumball.
description_zh: 在 Scrumball 网红营销平台找网红、跟进建联任务、处理网红回信、查看团队使用统计与剩余额度。用 Scrumball 账号登录授权，无需 API Key。
description_en: Find creators, follow outreach, triage creator emails and review team usage and credits on Scrumball.
examples_zh: 帮我在 TikTok 上找 20 个美国美妆博主，粉丝 5 万到 50 万
今天有哪些网红回信要我处理？超时没回的排前面
「夏季上新」这个任务里，哪些网红报了价？
最近 30 天建联效果怎么样？
examples_en: Find 20 US beauty creators on TikTok with 50k to 500k followers
What creator emails need my reply today? Overdue ones first
Which creators in the Summer Launch campaign quoted a price?
How did my outreach do in the last 30 days?
How many unlock credits do I have left?
